train_LabelSpreading_model: train a LabelSpreading model on the digits dataset with 40 labeled and 300 unlabeled points
generate_classification_report: generate a classification report for true and predicted labels from a fitted LabelSpreading model
plot_confusion_matrix: plot a confusion matrix from true and predicted labels using ConfusionMatrixDisplay
find_most_uncertain_predictions: find the 10 most uncertain predictions from a LabelSpreading model using entropy of label distributions
load_digits_dataset_subset: load the digits dataset and select a shuffled subset of 340 samples for semi-supervised learning
